conviction_note: My forward findings net to only -0.8 because three of the five are positive (the licensor is contractually locked up, no overnight offering was filed, and the only sell-side note on the record is a reiterated Buy), but the reaction function is more negative than the research read and I am letting it have the veto the brief gives it: 22.5x normal volume sits in the >15x band that averages -2.44% next session, ATR14 of 15.4% is deep in the tail of the one free ranker that survived a family-wise correction, and this name's own eight comparable falls median -0.42% with a 6.45% median absolute move. -2.5 is the blend, held well inside this stock's own next-day dispersion.
bar: The company's own stated forward pipeline and supply stack: a Phase 2b/3 in CSU and a Phase 2 in food allergy to be initiated with no dates given, the complete Phase 2 data set including the PK and IgE analyses deferred to an unnamed 'upcoming scientific meeting', 12 months of runway from the July 2026 $50m private placement, and 4,090,908 resale-registered warrant shares against 7,264,414 shares outstanding. Sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526396094/d21238d8k.htm (2026-09-21), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526352128/cue-20260630.htm (2026-08-14), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526255418/d103205ds3.htm (2026-06-03).

cause.label: clinical_or_binary_readout
cause.what_happened: Cue Biopharma, Inc. (Nasdaq: CUE, CIK 0001645460) put out positive topline Phase 2 data for CUE-221 in chronic spontaneous urticaria on Sunday 2026-09-20, the stock gapped up 3.91% on Monday 2026-09-21, and it then fell 26.6% intraday from the 08:00 ET conference call onward as the market read the detail: the trial was run in China by Genesis Life Sciences, an affiliate of the licensor Ascendant, the week-12 primary endpoint was only 54% vs 41% for the omalizumab comparator with a flat dose response (54/53/43% at 4/2/1 mg/kg) off an N=18 placebo arm, the differentiation claim rests on a post hoc week-28 analysis, and the PK and IgE analyses were not released.

evidence.claim: 8-K Items 7.01/8.01 filed 2026-09-21 at 08:00:17 ET reports positive topline Phase 2 CUE-221 CSU results, announced 2026-09-20, with a conference call at 8:00 a.m. ET on 2026-09-21; primary endpoint HSS7=0 at week 12 was 54%/53%/43% for 4/2/1 mg/kg vs 11% placebo (N=18) and 41% for omalizumab 300 mg (N=17), with the CUE-4mg vs omalizumab delta only 13 points at the primary endpoint and the statistically significant 36-point delta coming from a post hoc week-28 analysis

The press release states the trial was 'conducted in China' and that the company 'look[s] forward to presenting the complete data set including PK and IgE analyses from this 36-week study at an upcoming scientific meeting' - i.e. the two analyses the sell-side named as the reason for the weakness were withheld

Trade press framed the sell-off as a China-trial discount rather than a data failure ('China syndrome? Phase II wins for Cue in CSU, stock melts down'), and B. Riley attributed the share-price weakness specifically to the missing pharmacokinetic and IgE data while maintaining Buy with an $83 target

pipeline.next_dated_event: 2026-10-27 - the scheduled release of 50% of Ascendant Health Sciences' locked-up Cue securities, 180 days after the 2026-04-30 License Agreement, with a 25% tranche capable of releasing earlier (from roughly 2026-10-05 at the earliest) if the close holds at or above $22.00 for 10 of any 15 consecutive trading days after the announcement of the Phase 2 Milestone. Nothing dated falls inside the 2026-09-22 window.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A 424B5, S-3 takedown or Form D on the tape before the 2026-09-22 close, or a second sell-side note cutting rather than defending, would make this materially more negative; a named date for the scientific meeting carrying the PK and IgE analyses would make it materially less so.

positioning_check: Short interest is small and shrinking, and it is stale: 318,420 shares at the 08/31/2026 FINRA settlement, 1.76 days to cover, -2.8% vs the 08/14/2026 settlement, against 7,264,414 shares outstanding as of 2026-08-12 - about 4.4% of shares out, and FINRA publishes about eight business days late so the position carried into the 2026-09-21 fall is not observable (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/CUE/short-interest?assetclass=stocks; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526352128/cue-20260630.htm). There is no skew to read: the baseline records the chain as 'unusable_chain' with 425 total open interest and no two-sided ATM legs, so no straddle or 25-delta skew can be priced. Insider positioning is the opposite of the short book: CEO Shao-Lee Lin filed a Schedule 13D on 2026-08-21 reporting 467,166 shares, 6.2%, acquired with personal funds in the May 2026 offering at $11.00 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000172509226000015/primary_doc.xml), and Nasdaq's Form 4 summary shows 9 open-market buys against 4 sells in the last three months.

findings.finding: 4,090,908 resale-registered, un-locked-up warrant shares - 56% of the 7,264,414 shares outstanding, struck at $0.001 and $11.00 - remain saleable into the 2026-09-22 session, and the 2026-09-21 unwind that turned roughly 3.0m shares (about 42% of shares outstanding, $99.8m against a $4.2m median) did not switch off at the close.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This overhang has been live since 2026-06-17 and the stock still ran +50.5% over 20 days into the readout, so it does not sell continuously - it sells into liquidity. The two comparable falls that came after the May 2026 offering registered are 2026-08-17 (-19.18%, next close -7.02%) and 2026-04-21 (-21.18%, next close -13.43%), the two worst day-2 outcomes in this name's eight-event history.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the data. It has not taken the fact that the marginal seller in this name is a warrant holder at an effective $0.001 or $11.00 against a $28.27 close, whose selling is throttled by available volume rather than by conviction - so a day that prints 22.5x normal volume is the day that supply gets absorbed, and a day-2 with volume still elevated is the day it continues. If the price held this, the 2026-09-21 session would not have needed 42% of shares outstanding to clear and the stock would not have given back a 3.91% opening gap in full.
findings.independence: The S-3 registering these shares was declared effective 2026-06-17 (EFFECT, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/999999999526002046/xslEFFECTX01/primary_doc.xml), and the 10-Q independently confirms the May 2026 Offering issued pre-funded warrants for 2,727,272 shares plus warrants for 1,363,636 shares at $11.00 with a 4.85-year life (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526352128/cue-20260630.htm).

findings.finding: The holder with the largest paper gain and the clearest motive to sell - Ascendant Health Sciences, which took 551,724 pre-funded warrant shares as license consideration at $0.001 and has had them resale-registered since 2026-07-01 - is contractually barred from selling into the 2026-09-22 session, because its Investor Agreement lock-up does not begin releasing until 180 days after the 2026-04-30 License Agreement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior release has occurred - this is the first lock-up window in the agreement's life, so there is no reaction history on this line for this name and the finding is sized off the share count (551,724 shares, 7.6% of shares outstanding) rather than off a precedent.
findings.why_not_priced: A stock that falls 24% on its licensor's trial data prices as though the licensor is about to monetise. The future this price has not taken is that the licensor legally cannot, for another five weeks - so the supply that would normally follow a readout of this kind is date-shifted out of the window rather than absent. What would look different if the price held it is a day-2 that does not carry a licensor-distribution discount.
findings.independence: The same securities purchase agreement and Investor Agreement are described in the 10-Q's Ascendant License Agreement note (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526352128/cue-20260630.htm), which independently dates the Initial Closing to 2026-05-04.

findings.finding: The only sell-side action on the record after the fall is a defence, not a cut: B. Riley reiterated Buy with an $83 target on 2026-09-21, said it would accumulate into the 24% decline, and attributed the weakness to the missing PK and IgE data rather than to the result - so the estimate flow reaching the 2026-09-22 session carries no downgrade.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Coverage on this name is thin enough that one note is the whole flow; the baseline carries no prior estimate-revision event, so this is sized as the absence of the cascade of target cuts that normally follows a 24% drop rather than as a positive catalyst in its own right.
findings.why_not_priced: The price took the call. It has not taken the shape of the sell-side response, which is the thing that usually decides day 2 after a biotech readout: a stock that fell 24% into a wave of target cuts keeps falling, and one that fell 24% into a reiterated Buy at roughly three times spot with an explicit 'accumulate' has a bid under it that did not exist at 16:00 on 2026-09-21. If the price held this, the close would not have been at the low of the intraday range.
findings.independence: Reported independently by the trade press covering the move, which names the same $83 target and the same PK/IgE attribution (https://www.bioworld.com/articles/734191-china-syndrome-phase-ii-wins-for-cue-in-csu-stock-melts-down?v=preview).

findings.finding: The commonest second shoe after a biotech data day - an overnight equity raise off the shelf - did not fire: EDGAR carries no 424B5, S-3 takedown, Form D or new 8-K from CIK 0001645460 after the 2026-09-21 08:00 ET data filing, checked at 2026-09-22, so there is no dated dilution trigger inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This issuer has raised three times in five months - the May 2026 private placement ($27.6m net, closed 2026-05-04), the Ascendant license equity (2026-05-04) and the July 2026 private placement ($49.8m net, closed 2026-07-13) - and every one of them was a negotiated private placement announced by 8-K, not a same-night marketed follow-on, so the pattern that would have to repeat to hurt the window is one this issuer has not used.
findings.why_not_priced: A 24% fall on positive data is the market pricing dilution risk as much as trial risk - the company said in the same release it is moving to a Phase 2b/3 in CSU and a Phase 2 in food allergy, which it cannot fund from $17.4m of 30 June cash plus $49.8m of July proceeds. The future this price has not taken is that the raise, when it comes, is now a marketed deal into a repaired price rather than an overnight print into a collapsing one - the issuer forfeited the data-day window. If the price held this, the close would not have gone out at a level that assumes a deal is imminent.
findings.independence: The 10-Q states the July 2026 private placement alone funds operations 'at least through the next twelve months from the issuance date' of the 2026-08-14 financial statements, which is the company's own evidence that it is not forced to print a deal this week (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526352128/cue-20260630.htm).

findings.finding: The specific information gap that caused the fall will not be closed inside the window: the company committed only to presenting 'the complete data set including PK and IgE analyses from this 36-week study at an upcoming scientific meeting', naming no meeting and no date, so nothing arrives on 2026-09-22 to answer the objection the 08:00 ET call raised.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The nearest analogue in this name is 2025-12-19 (-21.64%, next close -5.22%) and 2026-04-21 (-21.18%, next close -13.43%), both falls where no clarifying document followed within a session; the two falls that bounced (+9.03% after 2026-01-15, +5.33% after 2025-04-01) are both smaller and on lower volume.
findings.why_not_priced: Intraday the market moved from a +3.91% gap to a -23.7% close as it worked out what was missing; the price now holds the objection. What it does not hold is the duration of the objection - that the answer is deferred to an unscheduled conference, so the discount cannot be argued away by a company statement tomorrow and has to be carried. If the price held this, the stock would not have closed at a level consistent with a prompt rebuttal.
findings.independence: B. Riley's note names the same two missing analyses, from outside the company, as the cause of the weakness (https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9090443/b-rileys-buy-rating-on-cue-biopharma-cue-highlights-markets-high-pricetosales-expectations).

outside_window.finding: Ascendant's lock-up starts releasing: 25% of the Subject Securities can release automatically from roughly 2026-10-05 at the earliest if the close holds at or above $22.00 (100% above $11.00) for 10 of any 15 consecutive trading days after the Phase 2 Milestone announcement, and 50% releases on schedule 180 days after the 2026-04-30 License Agreement. 551,724 registered shares at a $0.001 strike, 7.6% of shares outstanding.

Ascendant's Top-Up Shares: on achievement of specified clinical and financial Top-Up Milestones the licensor is issued shares taking it to no less than 7.5% of Outstanding Capital Stock, with a $15.0m minimum value and no cap above it, and with pre-funded warrants substituted for any Excess Shares needing a Nasdaq 5635 vote. A positive Phase 2 readout is exactly the kind of clinical milestone this contemplates; it would surface as an 8-K Item 3.02 or, at the latest, in the Q3 10-Q.

The funded Phase 2b/3 CSU and Phase 2 food allergy programmes do not fit inside the stated runway: $17.4m of cash at 2026-06-30 plus $49.8m net July proceeds against a company statement of twelve months from 2026-08-14, with $36.8m of unused capacity left on the $80m Jefferies ATM Sales Agreement ($43.2m sold since inception) available without an 8-K.

No registered CUE clinical study has a primary completion date near the window - NCT06917885 completes 2027-01-31, NCT04852328 2027-10-31 and NCT07172256 2031-02 - so there is no dated binary readout to come from the trial register in this quarter.

searched_and_found_nothing: An overnight or same-day financing: data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001645460.json shows the 2026-09-21 08:00:17 ET 8-K as the most recent filing of any form as at 2026-09-22, with no 424B5, no S-3 takedown, no Form D and no 8-K Item 3.02.

A date for the scientific meeting carrying the full PK and IgE data set - the 2026-09-20 press release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526396094/d21238dex991.htm) names neither the meeting nor a quarter, so the single most valuable forward catalyst in this name is undated and cannot be a finding.

A going-concern second shoe: the 2026-08-14 10-Q states the July 2026 private placement funds operations at least twelve months from issuance, which is why the baseline's 'substantial doubt about its ability to continue' probe returned 0 hits ever (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1645460/000119312526352128/cue-20260630.htm). The going-concern language in the 2026-07-10 8-K's risk factors predates that remediation.

A listing deficiency clock: the 10-Q records that on 2026-05-08 Nasdaq confirmed the company regained minimum-bid compliance after 10 consecutive sessions at or above $1.00 and that the matter is closed; at $28.27 the rule is not in play, and the baseline notes the Listing Center itself is 403 from here so no independent check was possible.
A restatement or non-reliance item: the baseline's 'non-reliance' full-text probe returns 0 hits ever across this issuer's filings.

A covenant or debt trigger: the most recent 'covenant' hits are 2026-03-16 S-3 exhibits, the 10-Q shows term loans repaid ($2.0m in the prior period, nil this period), and there is no outstanding facility whose covenants the fall could trip.
Federal litigation: no securities complaint could be sourced dated 2026-09-21 or 2026-09-22; a stock-drop suit on a positive-data fall is unusual and I found none, so nothing is claimed.
I deliberately did not look up CUE's 2026-09-22 intraday or closing price, because that is the outcome this hunt is scored on.
baseline_tension: It cuts both ways and the halves do not net to zero: the 22.5x volume spike (>15x band averages -2.44% next session) and the 15.4% ATR14 (the single free ranker that cleared a family-wise correction, and it says high-vol fallers keep falling) point harder down than my findings do, while this name's own eight comparable falls are a coin flip (50% up, median -0.42%, median absolute 6.45%) and three of my five findings are positive - so my emitted -2.5 sits between a -0.8 research read and a reaction function that is more bearish than the research, which is the one direction the brief lets the reaction function override in.
